openQuestions.question: Whether AIChatWorkspace CR creation is actually granted to untrusted tenants in production (vs. platform-engineers only) determines the practical likelihood of the workspaceName tenant-isolation finding; no RBAC binding granting the editor role to end users is committed.

Whether the cluster ingress controller routes the generated <workspace>[-api].defaultDomain hosts publicly determines the real-world exposure of the unauthenticated Ollama API; this depends on cluster DNS/ingress configuration outside the repository.

surfaces.label: internal/controller - AIChatWorkspace reconciliation, resource lifecycle, namespace/ingress/ollama/openwebui handling
internal/adapters/ollama - model pull/create/list via Ollama SDK
internal/adapters/k8s - resource constructors (Namespace, ServiceAccount, PVC, Service, Ingress, StatefulSet, Deployment) and pod exec helper
internal/config and internal/constants - operator configuration from ConfigMap, image tags, domain
api/v1alpha1 - AIChatWorkspace CRD types and CEL validation rules
cmd/main.go - manager setup, metrics/probe servers, webhook server, pprof (localhost-bound)
config/rbac - operator manager ClusterRole and editor/viewer roles
